cues.name: Hook
cues.note: Nobody reads your README. Workaround tags struck out on the half beats.

cues.name: Reveal
cues.note: The drop: a bronze gate slams shut. Your agent presents SIZZLE. Your app, now showing.

cues.name: Collapse
cues.note: The poster and the bronze shrink into the film-frame mark of the Sizzle lockup in the brand bar.

cues.name: Install
cues.note: npx skills add mhfrough/sizzle, and the skill's files land.

cues.name: Ask
cues.note: make a promo reel for this app. The agent reads the code.

cues.name: Script
cues.note: This reel's own shot list writes itself.

cues.name: Cut
cues.note: The live CUES object prints; each cue drops its block on the timeline.

cues.name: Picture lock
cues.note: This reel's own contact sheet. Approve. PICTURE LOCK.

cues.name: Mix
cues.note: The track's real waveform slides until the drop at 57.02 s locks onto the reveal at 2.95 s.

cues.name: Print
cues.note: Frame 000 to 750 while the reel's frames pass through the gate.

cues.name: CTA
cues.note: The gate slams again: the Sizzle lockup, the install line, the URL, the billing block.

shotList.title: Hook
shotList.text: NOBODY READS YOUR README. Your app deserves a trailer. Four workaround tags (README.md, screenshot-final-v3.png, demo.gif, walkthrough.mov) are struck out and fall.

shotList.title: Reveal
shotList.text: On the drop, bronze gates slam shut with a flash at the seam. The film-frame mark, YOUR AGENT PRESENTS, SIZZLE, Your app, now showing. The poster collapses into the film-frame mark of the brand bar lockup.

shotList.title: 01 Install
shotList.text: ONE LINE TO INSTALL. npx skills add mhfrough/sizzle; sizzle added; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode; skills/sizzle/ with SKILL.md, templates/, tools/, references/.

shotList.title: 02 Ask
shotList.text: THEN JUST ASK. "make a promo reel for this app". The agent: Reading your code. Writing the script.

shotList.title: 03 Script
shotList.text: IT WRITES THE SCRIPT. This reel's own shot list types itself, row by row.

shotList.title: 04 Cut
shotList.text: CUT ON CUE, IN HTML. sizzle-reel.html: the CUES object, the timeline blocks, a 9:16 preview, a playhead.

shotList.title: 05 Picture lock
shotList.text: YOU APPROVE IT FIRST. The contact sheet of this reel's stills, Approve, PICTURE LOCK.

shotList.title: 06 Mix
shotList.text: THE DROP HITS THE REVEAL. music_sync.py: hit 57.02 s, offset 54.07, pre -14.6 dB, body -8.9 dB, fits yes.

shotList.title: 07 Print
shotList.text: RENDERED FRAME BY FRAME. reel.py all: frame 000 to 750; sizzle-reel.mp4, 2160 x 3840, 25 s, -14 LUFS.

shotList.title: CTA
shotList.text: A SKILL FOR AI AGENTS. The Sizzle lockup (film-frame mark + SIZZLE). Your app, now showing. npx skills add mhfrough/sizzle. mhfrough.github.io/sizzle.
